title: DP20365 The Pricing of Profit Shifting
title_zh: 利润转移的定价
title_primary: 利润转移的定价
title_secondary: DP20365 The Pricing of Profit Shifting
authors: Fotis Delis, Manthos Delis, Sotirios Kokas, Luc Laeven, Steven Ongena
official: 官方在线 2025-06-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Profit shifting by multinational enterprises (MNEs) increases after-tax earnings but can expose firms to regulatory and reputational risks. We examine how stock markets price profit shifting using global profit shifting estimates from approximately 30,000 MNE-year observations between 2010 and 2020. We find that a one standard deviation increase in profit shifting is associated with 6.4% higher monthly stock returns, indicating that stock markets require compensation for the underlying risks. The identified effects become significant only after the initiation of the Base Erosion and Profit Shifting program and gain further strength following the implementation of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act.
abstract_zh: 跨国企业（MNEs）的利润转移提高了税后收益，但可能使企业面临监管和声誉风险。我们利用2010年至2020年间约30,000个跨国企业-年度观测值的全球利润转移估计，考察股票市场如何对利润转移进行定价。研究发现，利润转移每增加一个标准差，月度股票回报率相应提高6.4%，这表明股票市场要求对潜在风险进行补偿。这一效应仅在税基侵蚀与利润转移项目启动后才变得显著，并在《减税与就业法案》实施后进一步增强。

title: A General Randomized Test for Alpha
title_zh: 一种通用的Alpha随机化检验
title_primary: 一种通用的Alpha随机化检验
title_secondary: A General Randomized Test for Alpha
authors: Lucio Sarno, Daniele Massacci, Lorenzo Trapani, Pierluigi Vallarino
official: 官方在线 2026-09-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We propose a methodology to test for the null hypothesis that the alphas of a panel of asset returns are jointly equal to zero in a linear factor pricing model with observable and tradable factors — that is, the null of “zero alpha”. The test is based on equation-by- equation estimation, using a randomized version of the estimated alphas, which only requires rates of convergence. The distinct features of the proposed methodology are that it does not require the estimation of any covariance matrix, and that it allows for both N and T to pass to infinity, with the former possibly faster than the latter. Further, unlike extant approaches, the procedure can accommodate conditional heteroskedasticity, non-Gaussianity, and strong cross-sectional dependence in the error terms. We also propose a derandomized decision rule to choose in favor or against the correct specification of a linear factor pricing model. Monte Carlo simulations show that the test has satisfactory properties and it compares favorably to several existing tests. The usefulness of the testing procedure is illustrated through an application of linear factor pricing models to the constituents of the S&P 500.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种检验方法，用于在线性因子定价模型中，针对可观测且可交易因子，检验一组资产收益的alpha是否联合为零的原假设——即“零alpha”原假设。该检验基于逐方程估计，采用估计alpha的随机化版本，仅需收敛速率即可。所提方法的显著特点在于，它无需估计任何协方差矩阵，并且允许N和T同时趋于无穷大，其中前者可能快于后者。此外，与现有方法不同，该程序能够适应误差项中的条件异方差性、非高斯性以及强横截面依赖性。我们还提出了一种去随机化决策规则，以选择支持或反对线性因子定价模型的正确设定。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，该检验具有令人满意的性质，并且优于若干现有检验。通过将线性因子定价模型应用于标普500指数成分股，我们展示了该检验程序的实际效用。

title: Directedness in Search
title_zh: 搜索中的方向性
title_primary: 搜索中的方向性
title_secondary: Directedness in Search
authors: George Molnar
official: 官方在线 2026-01-23 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This chapter explains an essential feature of power properties: directedness, which provides a direction to a particular manifestation. The chapter contends that the connection between power and manifestation is a difficult but necessary task for the theory of powers. It evaluates the strengths and faults of the Brentano thesis, and analyses the topic of intentionality, which includes the parallels between psychological intentionality and physical intentionality. The chapter also provides accounts of the objections to physical intentionality, including impossible intentional objects, the threat of panpsychism, unique intentional objects, and the deluge of necessities. Lastly, the chapter proposes to treat physical intentionality as an undefined primitive of the theory of properties.
abstract_zh: 本章阐释了能力属性的一个基本特征：方向性，它为特定表现提供了指向。本章主张，能力与表现之间的联系是能力理论中一项艰巨但必要的任务。本章评估了布伦塔诺论点的优势与不足，并分析了意向性主题，包括心理意向性与物理意向性之间的相似之处。本章还阐述了针对物理意向性的反对意见，包括不可能意向对象、泛心论的威胁、独特意向对象以及必然性的泛滥。最后，本章提议将物理意向性视为属性理论中一个未定义的原始概念。

title: Barriers and Bridges: The Trade, Productivity, and Welfare Effects of the Belt and Road Initiative
title_zh: 《障碍与桥梁：“一带一路”倡议的贸易、生产率与福利效应》
title_primary: 《障碍与桥梁：“一带一路”倡议的贸易、生产率与福利效应》
title_secondary: Barriers and Bridges: The Trade, Productivity, and Welfare Effects of the Belt and Road Initiative
authors: Shuangcen Li
official: 官方在线 2026-08-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper evaluates the impact of the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) on trade, productivity, and welfare using a multi‐country, multi‐sector Ricardian model with input–output linkages. Gravity estimates reveal asymmetric trade effects: BRI participation increases imports from China in textiles, wood and paper, and electrical machinery, while raising exports to China in metals. These effects are not driven by tariff reductions and are stronger among countries with regional trade agreements (RTAs) with China in several sectors. I then recover model‐implied country‐sector productivity and estimate its response to BRI participation using difference‐in‐differences methods. I find no broad productivity gains from BRI participation. Instead, sectors whose input needs are more closely matched with China's upstream exports experience stronger productivity growth relative to other sectors within the same country, becoming significant in the third year after participation. Counterfactual simulations show that removing the estimated trade cost and productivity effects reduces welfare in BRI countries and China, while generating smaller losses for non‐BRI countries. When the United States raises tariffs on China, China's welfare loss is slightly larger in the absence of the BRI, suggesting that the BRI provides a modest buffer against adverse tariff shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文利用一个包含投入产出关联的多国、多部门李嘉图模型，评估了“一带一路”倡议（BRI）对贸易、生产率和福利的影响。引力模型估计揭示了不对称的贸易效应：参与BRI增加了从中国进口的纺织品、木材与纸张以及电气机械，同时提高了向中国出口的金属产品。这些效应并非由关税削减驱动，且在多个部门中，与中国签订区域贸易协定（RTAs）的国家中效应更为显著。随后，我恢复了模型隐含的国家-部门生产率，并采用双重差分法估计其对BRI参与的响应。我发现BRI参与并未带来广泛的生产率提升。相反，其投入需求与中国上游出口更为匹配的部门，在同一国家内相对于其他部门经历了更强的生产率增长，并在参与后的第三年变得显著。反事实模拟显示，消除估计的贸易成本和生产率效应会降低BRI国家和中国的福利，而对非BRI国家造成的损失较小。当美国对中国提高关税时，若无BRI，中国的福利损失略大，这表明BRI为应对不利关税冲击提供了适度的缓冲。

title: AI feedback loops and the conditions for explosive growth
title_zh: 人工智能反馈循环与爆炸性增长的条件
title_primary: 人工智能反馈循环与爆炸性增长的条件
title_secondary: AI feedback loops and the conditions for explosive growth
authors: Tom Davidson, Basil Halperin, Thomas Houlden, Anton Korinek
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: If frontier AI models can be used to develop their next models, this may lead to an ‘intelligence explosion’ and give a large boost to technological advancement. This column develops a framework for understanding how AI may transform the economy through new feedback loops. It shows that the potential for explosive growth depends on the labour share, the returns to research effort, and the share of automated tasks in each sector, and that the threshold may be surprisingly low. Bottlenecks in tasks that remain human, physical constraints on compute, and the pace of automation will shape whether these dynamics materialise.
abstract_zh: 如果前沿AI模型能够被用于开发其下一代模型，这可能导致“智能爆炸”，并极大地推动技术进步。本专栏构建了一个框架，用以理解AI如何通过新的反馈循环变革经济。研究表明，爆炸性增长的可能性取决于劳动份额、研究努力的回报以及各部门中自动化任务的占比，且这一门槛可能低得惊人。人类仍承担的任务中的瓶颈、计算能力的物理限制以及自动化的步伐，将决定这些动态是否会成为现实。

title: How do common pool natural resources relate to rural income, poverty and inequality? A multi-country assessment
title_zh: 共同资源性自然资源与农村收入、贫困和不平等的关系：一项跨国评估
title_primary: 共同资源性自然资源与农村收入、贫困和不平等的关系：一项跨国评估
title_secondary: How do common pool natural resources relate to rural income, poverty and inequality? A multi-country assessment
authors: Anamika Das, Sharachchandra Lele, Brian Robinson, Geoff Wells, Suman Attiwilli 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The role of Common Pool natural Resources (CPRs) such as forests, grasslands, rivers, lakes, wetlands and oceans in rural economies has been much debated in the literature, often on the basis of micro-level or provincial-scale analyses and focusing on a single type of CPR, typically forests. This study draws on data from 6,509 households across fifteen regions in nine low and middle-income countries covering Africa, Asia, and Latin America that also cover a diverse set of CPRs, including forests, savannas, grasslands, mangroves and inland and marine fisheries. We estimate the contribution of CPR-based income to total household income and vis-a-vis the poverty line across income classes, and analyse the correlates of CPR-based income and the relationship between CPR income and income inequality within rural settlements. Our results highlight three important aspects of the CPR-rural income relationship. First, they confirm that CPR-based income makes up a significant portion of the income of the rural poor even across diverse geographies and CPRs. Households below the World Bank $1.9 per capita per day poverty line derive on average one fourth of their household income from CPRs. Second, the regression results highlight the importance of physical resource abundance and social accessibility, household demography, the regional demographic/market context, and most importantly the complementary productive assets owned by households in deriving income from CPRs. Third, there is a distinct correlation between the broad nature of CPR harvest technologies and income-inequality: when the harvest technology is capital-intensive, richer households derive more monetary benefit from CPRs, not only in absolute terms but also in terms of share in household income, leading to a situation where such CPRs exacerbate inequality within settlements. Our results highlight the importance of integrating a diversity of CPRs and CPR availability, access and technological context into CPR studies. They also highlight the need for pro-poor policies that go beyond securing resource access and include support for the poor to access technologies and markets.
abstract_zh: 诸如森林、草地、河流、湖泊、湿地和海洋等公共池资源（CPRs）在农村经济中的作用，在文献中一直备受争议，这些讨论往往基于微观层面或省级尺度的分析，并聚焦于单一类型的CPR，尤其是森林。本研究利用来自非洲、亚洲和拉丁美洲九个中低收入国家十五个地区的6509户家庭数据，这些数据覆盖了包括森林、稀树草原、草地、红树林以及内陆和海洋渔业在内的多种CPR类型。我们估算了基于CPR的收入对家庭总收入的贡献，并对照贫困线分析了不同收入阶层的情况，同时探讨了CPR收入的相关因素以及CPR收入与农村居民点内部收入不平等之间的关系。我们的研究结果凸显了CPR与农村收入关系的三个重要方面。首先，研究证实，即使在不同地理环境和CPR类型下，基于CPR的收入在农村贫困人口收入中占据重要份额。低于世界银行每人每天1.9美元贫困线的家庭，平均约有四分之一的家庭收入来源于CPR。其次，回归结果强调了物质资源丰富度和社会可及性、家庭人口特征、区域人口/市场背景，以及最为关键的家庭所拥有的互补性生产资产在从CPR获取收入中的重要性。第三，CPR收获技术的广泛性质与收入不平等之间存在显著相关性：当收获技术为资本密集型时，较富裕的家庭从CPR中获得的货币收益更多，不仅在绝对数额上，而且在家庭收入占比上也是如此，从而导致此类CPR加剧了居民点内部的不平等。我们的研究结果强调了将CPR的多样性、可用性、获取途径和技术背景纳入CPR研究的重要性，同时也凸显了制定有利于贫困人口政策的必要性，这些政策不仅要确保资源获取，还要支持贫困人口获得技术和市场准入。

title: Evidence of How Electronic Reporting and Automated Auditing Affects Regulatory Compliance and Environmental Performance
title_zh: 电子报告与自动审计对监管合规及环境绩效影响的实证证据
title_primary: 电子报告与自动审计对监管合规及环境绩效影响的实证证据
title_secondary: Evidence of How Electronic Reporting and Automated Auditing Affects Regulatory Compliance and Environmental Performance
authors: Wayne B. Gray, Ronald Shadbegian, Ann Wolverton
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We investigate whether, by providing better and more timely information, the first mandatory online reporting and auditing program for wastewater discharge releases in the U.S. improved facility compliance and environmental performance, while also allowing state regulators to more effectively monitor and enforce regulations. Examining reporting programs with automated feedback features can also offer insights into the potential for artificial intelligence-based tools to improve compliance and environmental performance. Difference-in-difference results suggest that the program resulted in significant increases in the completeness of reporting and reductions in discharges but also greater reported violations. We find that effects are larger for minor dischargers and publicly owned facilities. We also find evidence consistent with the more efficient targeting of inspections by state authorities towards plants with a history of recent noncompliance, which could be a potential mechanism driving these results.
abstract_zh: 本文探究美国首个针对废水排放的强制性在线报告与审计制度，是否通过提供更优质、更及时的信息，提升了设施合规性与环境绩效，同时使州监管机构能够更有效地监督和执行法规。研究具有自动反馈功能的报告制度，也可为基于人工智能的工具在改善合规性与环境绩效方面的潜力提供启示。双重差分结果表明，该制度显著提高了报告的完整性，减少了污染物排放量，但同时也增加了报告的违规事件。我们发现，对小型排放者及公有设施的影响更为显著。此外，证据表明州监管机构更高效地将检查资源集中于近期存在违规历史的工厂，这可能是驱动上述结果的潜在机制。

title: Energy prices, inflation, and the ECB’s monetary policy during the 2021-22 energy crisis
title_zh: 能源价格、通胀与2021-22年能源危机期间欧洲央行的货币政策
title_primary: 能源价格、通胀与2021-22年能源危机期间欧洲央行的货币政策
title_secondary: Energy prices, inflation, and the ECB’s monetary policy during the 2021-22 energy crisis
authors: Stefano Neri
official: 官方在线 2026-07-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper quantifies the effects of energy price shocks in the euro area and examines the role of ECB monetary policy during the energy crisis. Using a Bayesian VAR identified with sign and narrative restrictions, local projections, and counterfactuals, I show that energy shocks induce persistent and broad-based inflationary pressures while reducing real activity. The pass-through to inflation is state-dependent: it is sizeable and persistent only when inflation is already elevated and when the shock originates from gas and electricity prices. A counterfactual exercise shows that an earlier and more forceful monetary policy tightening would have reduced inflation only at the cost of a sizeable output loss.
abstract_zh: 本文量化了欧元区能源价格冲击的影响，并考察了欧洲央行在能源危机期间的货币政策作用。通过采用基于符号约束与叙事约束识别的贝叶斯向量自回归模型、局部投影法及反事实分析，研究表明能源冲击在抑制实际经济活动的同时，引发了持续且广泛的通胀压力。通胀传导呈现状态依赖性：仅当通胀水平已处于高位且冲击源自天然气与电力价格时，传导效应才显著且持久。反事实模拟显示，若更早实施更强力的货币政策紧缩，虽能降低通胀，但需以显著产出损失为代价。

title: Economic Incentives and Hospitalization in Germany
title_zh: 德国经济激励与住院率
title_primary: 德国经济激励与住院率
title_secondary: Economic Incentives and Hospitalization in Germany
authors: Klaus F. Zimmermann, Ralph Rotte, Andreas Million, Diogo Britto, Clément Imbert 等
official: 官方在线 1996-11-30 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this paper contributes to this literature by investigating factors determining the demand for hospitalization in Germany. While most previous studies have found a significant impact of social insurance on the demand for hospital trips, the empirical results presented here cast doubts on the propelling role of those economic incentives in the German case. There are also important differences in the hospitalization behaviour of men and women and between the full sample and those who are chronically ill, which have been neglected by the literature. The analysis relies on various count data models including Poisson, NEGBIN, ZIP (/), hurdle Poisson and NEGBIN panel models, and the findings are rather robust.
abstract_zh: 本文通过探究德国住院需求的决定因素，为该领域文献做出贡献。尽管以往多数研究发现社会保险对住院需求具有显著影响，但本文的实证结果对经济激励在德国案例中的推动作用提出了质疑。此外，男性和女性在住院行为上存在显著差异，全样本与慢性病患者群体之间也存在重要差异，而这些差异此前被文献所忽视。本研究采用多种计数数据模型进行分析，包括泊松模型、负二项模型、零膨胀泊松模型、障碍泊松模型及负二项面板模型，研究结果具有较高的稳健性。

title: Immigrants' Legal Status and Firms: Evidence from the 2007 EU Enlargement
title_zh: 移民法律地位与企业：来自2007年欧盟扩大的证据
title_primary: 移民法律地位与企业：来自2007年欧盟扩大的证据
title_secondary: Immigrants' Legal Status and Firms: Evidence from the 2007 EU Enlargement
authors: Vittoria Dicandia, Silvia Vannutelli
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how firms and workers adjust when previously restricted migrants gain full and portable work rights in a labor market with substantial informality. We exploit the 2007 EU accession of Bulgaria and Romania, which granted unrestricted work rights to Italy's largest migrant group. Using matched employer–employee administrative data and an IV-DID design, we find that firms suddenly and persistently shift employment composition toward EU07 workers, compressing the native employment share without reducing native hiring or increasing separations. We don't detect any significant change in wages for either natives or EU07 workers. For migrants, this null effect reflects offsetting compositional shifts as newly observed and incumbent EU07 workers enter the formal workforce with different wage trajectories. Consistent with a shift in bargaining power toward workers, EU07 migrants experienced significant gains in job mobility and job security. Overall, the evidence suggests that removing legal restrictions reshaped firms’ personnel choices and altered migrants’ employment relationships, improving their outside options, bargaining position, and access to more secure jobs.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在高度非正规化的劳动力市场中，当此前受限制的移民获得完全且可携带的工作权利时，企业与工人如何调整。我们利用2007年保加利亚和罗马尼亚加入欧盟这一事件，该事件赋予了意大利最大移民群体不受限制的工作权利。通过使用匹配的雇主-雇员行政数据以及工具变量双重差分法，我们发现企业突然且持续地将就业结构转向欧盟07工人，压缩了本土工人的就业份额，但并未减少本土工人的雇佣或增加其离职率。我们未检测到本土工人或欧盟07工人的工资发生显著变化。对于移民而言，这一零效应反映了新观测到的欧盟07工人与在职欧盟07工人以不同工资轨迹进入正规劳动力市场时，所引发的抵消性结构变化。与工人议价能力增强的趋势一致，欧盟07移民在工作流动性和工作保障方面获得了显著提升。总体而言，证据表明，取消法律限制重塑了企业的人事选择，改变了移民的雇佣关系，改善了他们的外部选择、议价地位以及获得更稳定工作的机会。

title: To Bid or Not to Bid? Entry, Bid Shading, and Bias in Sponsored Search Auctions
title_zh: 投标还是不投标？赞助搜索拍卖中的进入、出价遮蔽与偏差

title_secondary: To Bid or Not to Bid? Entry, Bid Shading, and Bias in Sponsored Search Auctions
authors: Eeva Mauring, Anastasiia Parakhonyak, Cole Williams
official: 官方在线 2026-07-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study participation in sponsored-search auctions when sellers can also appear as organic results. Under the platform’s ex post revenue-maximizing display rule, organic placement acts as an endogenous outside option: the best-matched sellers shade their bids and entry into bidding remains incomplete. The platform gains by committing to show more sponsored results than is ex post optimal, degrading match quality. Empirically, using Amazon search data and a Gini-based measure of query breadth, we confirm the model’s predictions: narrower queries receive fewer sponsored results, and sponsored results are worse matched than organic ones, especially for narrow queries.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了当卖家也能以自然搜索结果出现时，其参与赞助搜索拍卖的行为。在平台事后收益最大化的展示规则下，自然排名充当了内生外部选择：匹配度最高的卖家会压低出价，且竞价参与仍不充分。平台通过承诺展示比事后最优更多的赞助结果来获益，但这会降低匹配质量。基于亚马逊搜索数据及基尼系数衡量的查询广度，我们实证验证了模型预测：窄查询获得的赞助结果更少，且赞助结果的匹配质量低于自然结果，尤其在窄查询中更为显著。

title: ChatGPT’s financial advice: Supply, demand, and the life cycle

authors: Taha Choukhmane, Tim de Silva, Weidong Lin, Matthew Akuzawa
official: 官方在线 2026-06-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The rise of generative AI has raised hopes that high-quality, personalised financial advice might finally become cheap and universally accessible. This column develops a method to quantify the impact of following AI financial advice over a lifetime. The authors find that on the decisions that matter most for long-run wealth, such as investing in diversified equity or building a savings buffer, today’s leading models give advice broadly consistent with what economists would prescribe. But what people get from AI depends as much on the model's ability as on how they write their prompts, with the advice varying by gender, financial literacy, and prior AI experience.
abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能的兴起引发了人们的期待：高质量、个性化的财务建议或许终于能够变得廉价且普及。本文提出了一种方法，用以量化遵循人工智能财务建议对一生财富的影响。作者发现，在影响长期财富的关键决策上，例如投资多元化股票或建立储蓄缓冲，当前领先的模型给出的建议与经济学家通常推荐的内容基本一致。然而，人们从人工智能中获得的建议不仅取决于模型的能力，还取决于他们如何编写提示词，且建议内容因性别、金融素养和先前的人工智能使用经验而异。

title: When trust in official statistics declines

abstract: Trust in official economic statistics has become an increasingly salient policy issue, including in the US where the Commissioner of the Bureau of Labor Statistics was dismissed in August 2025 amid allegations that agency data had been manipulated. This column shows that the events produced a sharp increase in economic policy uncertainty, with existing estimates linking uncertainty to macroeconomic outcomes implying that the resulting loss of confidence may have reduced US GDP by roughly $20 billion. While some economic activity postponed during periods of uncertainty may eventually occur later, there are reasons to believe that at least part of the effect could be lasting.
abstract_zh: 对官方经济统计数据的信任已成为日益突出的政策问题，包括在美国，劳工统计局局长于2025年8月因机构数据被操纵的指控而被解雇。本专栏显示，这些事件导致经济政策不确定性急剧上升，现有估计将不确定性与宏观经济结果联系起来，表明由此产生的信心丧失可能使美国GDP减少约200亿美元。尽管在不确定性期间推迟的部分经济活动最终可能发生，但有理由相信至少部分影响可能是持久的。

title: Alcohol consumption in an empty nest
title_zh: 空巢中的酒精消费
title_primary: 空巢中的酒精消费

authors: Francesco Scervini, Serena Trucchi
official: 官方在线 2026-06-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper contributes to the understanding of alcohol consumption in adulthood by investigating the impact of a specific life event: the transition to an empty nest, when adult children move out of the parental home. Our findings using English data show a significant increase in alcohol consumption in an empty nest, characterised by more regular drinking patterns and a moderate increase in daily intake. The most affected groups include couples, high-income individuals, those actively employed, and respondents aged 45–60. We also provide evidence on the mechanisms underlying this relationship, supporting a key role of relaxation and changes in time use.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文通过研究特定生活事件——空巢期（即成年子女搬离父母家庭）的影响，深化了对成年期饮酒行为的理解。基于英国数据的分析表明，空巢期显著增加了饮酒量，表现为饮酒频率更规律且日均摄入量适度上升。受影响最显著的群体包括夫妻、高收入者、在职人员及45-60岁受访者。我们还揭示了这一关联背后的作用机制，证实了放松效应与时间分配变化的关键作用。

abstract: We investigate the complementarity and adoption intensity of ecological agriculture practices (EAPs) among Midwestern farmers, with a focus on environmental stewardship and profit-maximization motives. Using survey-level data on farmer characteristics in the US Midwest, we employ multivariate probit (MVP) and Poisson regressions to assess these linkages. The MVP results indicate that the degree of complementarity between EAPs varies in magnitude, with the highest complementarity between diversified crop rotation and integrated crop-livestock systems (50%). Regarding the adoption intensity, we find that farmersÕ decisions are influenced by both ecological and economic interests, with environmental stewardship motive playing a greater role.

title: Brazil’s pacifying police units revisited: A failed democratic policing project and lessons for institutional reforms
title_zh: 巴西安抚警察部队再审视：一项失败的民主警务计划及其对制度改革的启示
title_primary: 巴西安抚警察部队再审视：一项失败的民主警务计划及其对制度改革的启示
title_secondary: Brazil’s pacifying police units revisited: A failed democratic policing project and lessons for institutional reforms
authors: Julia Maia Goldani, Mariana Mota Prado
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Brazil’s Pacifying Police Units (UPPs) were an incremental police reform project implemented in Rio de Janeiro in 2008. Though initially celebrated as an innovate approach for reducing police violence, the project did not produce substantive changes in the structure of local police forces, their violent practices, or the state’s historically poor public security outcomes. It has since been characterized as a failed reform, suggesting that some scholars’ early skepticism was warranted. This paper revisits the initial enthusiasm in light of these disappointing results and draws on recent empirical research to assess what specific lessons can be taken from the UPP experience. We argue that the initiative’s failure can be traced back to three main factors: temporality (how fast the project expanded), governance (how independent the project was from the existing police institutions), and scope of the reform (how structural were the changes proposed). These shortcomings hindered the UPPs ability to innovate and overcome internal resistance to change. We suggest these dynamics may offer insights applicable to other institutional reforms.
abstract_zh: 巴西的维和警察单位（UPPs）是2008年在里约热内卢实施的一项渐进式警察改革项目。尽管最初被誉为减少警察暴力的创新方法，该项目并未在地方警察部队的结构、其暴力行为或国家历史上糟糕的公共安全成果方面产生实质性变化。此后，该项目被定性为失败的改革，这表明一些学者早期的怀疑是有道理的。本文基于这些令人失望的结果重新审视了最初的热情，并借鉴近期的实证研究来评估从UPP经验中可以汲取哪些具体教训。我们认为，该倡议的失败可追溯至三个主要因素：时间性（项目扩张的速度）、治理（项目与现有警察机构的独立性）以及改革范围（所提议变革的结构性程度）。这些缺陷阻碍了UPPs创新及克服内部变革阻力的能力。我们提出，这些动态可能为其他制度改革提供可借鉴的见解。

title: Financial intermediation and structural change
title_zh: 金融中介与结构性变化
title_primary: 金融中介与结构性变化
title_secondary: Financial intermediation and structural change
authors: David Jones, Corrado Di Maria, Simone Valente
official: 官方在线 2026-05-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Does financial intermediation affect structural change? We address this question both theoretically and empirically, focusing on whether financial development reinforces structural change during the post‐industrialization phase, where employment, value‐added, and expenditure shares change towards services and away from manufacturing. We build a dynamic general equilibrium model in which structural change may be driven by mutually independent engines – sectoral productivity gaps, asymmetric factor elasticities – as well as by learning‐by‐doing. In all its variants, the model robustly predicts that exogenous reductions in intermediation costs (e.g., deregulation shocks) reinforce structural change. We take this prediction to the data by examining the effects of bank branching deregulation in the United States in the period from the 1960s to the 1990s. Within a staggered difference‐in‐differences framework, we show that bank branching deregulation reinforces the pattern of structural change already underway, leading to an increase in the services share of output and employment in deregulated states.
abstract_zh: 金融中介是否影响结构变迁？我们从理论与实证两个层面探讨这一问题，重点关注金融发展在后工业化阶段是否强化了结构变迁——即就业、增加值与支出份额从制造业向服务业转移的过程。我们构建了一个动态一般均衡模型，其中结构变迁可能由相互独立的驱动因素——部门生产率差距、非对称要素弹性——以及干中学效应共同推动。在所有模型变体中，该模型稳健地预测：中介成本的外生降低（如放松管制冲击）会强化结构变迁。为验证这一预测，我们考察了美国20世纪60年代至90年代银行分支放松管制的效应。在交错双重差分框架下，我们证明银行分支放松管制强化了已在进行中的结构变迁模式，导致放松管制州的服务业产出与就业份额上升。

title: Do you get what you pay for?
title_zh: 你花的钱值不值？

authors: Wei-Shiun Chang, Sarah Jane Ereneo, Timothy C. Salmon
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Prior literature involving the Gift-Exchange Game (GEG) finds that employee effort is increasing with the magnitude of a fixed wage. We re-examine the relationship between effort and wages in a new paradigm, the Wage Request Game (WRG), in which the worker requests their wage. The main mechanisms thought to deliver the GEG results are not present in the WRG which should lead to a different relationship between wages and effort. Our findings show instead that the relationship between effort and wages is unrelated to the origin of the wage. These findings suggest a new explanation for the commonly observed relationship between wages and effort.
abstract_zh: 先前涉及礼物交换博弈（GEG）的文献发现，员工努力程度随固定工资水平的提高而增加。我们在一种新的范式——工资请求博弈（WRG）中重新审视了努力与工资之间的关系，在该博弈中，工人自行请求其工资。被认为产生GEG结果的主要机制在WRG中并不存在，这应导致工资与努力之间呈现不同的关系。然而，我们的研究结果显示，努力与工资之间的关系与工资的来源无关。这些发现为工资与努力之间普遍观察到的关系提供了一种新的解释。

title: Public health reforms and the mortality decline in nineteenth‐century Italy
title_zh: 19世纪意大利公共卫生改革与死亡率下降
title_primary: 19世纪意大利公共卫生改革与死亡率下降
title_secondary: Public health reforms and the mortality decline in nineteenth‐century Italy
authors: Francesco Maria Salvatore Fiore Melacrinis, Mauro Rota
official: 官方在线 2026-04-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines the impact of Italy's 1887–8 health reforms on mortality, contributing to the historical debate on the state's role in Europe's health transition. Leveraging event‐study‐style difference‐in‐differences approach, we assess the effectiveness of the Crispi–Pagliani reforms, which strengthened public health governance and introduced targeted non‐pharmaceutical interventions to mitigate deaths from infectious diseases. Mortality from targeted diseases decreased by 8.5 per cent relative to non‐targeted diseases within 5 years of the reforms. The results highlight the role of sanitary surveillance and coordinated governance, particularly effective in less‐educated regions, where public authorities compensated for limited health knowledge and prompted information flow in a broader process of top‐down modernization.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了意大利1887-1888年卫生改革对死亡率的影响，为关于国家在欧洲健康转型中作用的历史辩论提供了新证据。采用事件研究式双重差分法，我们评估了克里斯皮-帕利亚尼改革的有效性，该改革强化了公共卫生治理，并引入了针对性的非药物干预措施以降低传染病死亡率。改革实施后五年内，目标疾病的死亡率相对于非目标疾病下降了8.5%。研究结果凸显了卫生监督与协调治理的作用，尤其在教育水平较低地区效果显著，在这些地区，公共当局弥补了健康知识的不足，并在自上而下的现代化进程中促进了信息流动。

title: Price discovery and long-distance market integration: Evidence from the Republican Chinese Cotton Goods Exchange
title_zh: 价格发现与远距离市场整合：来自民国时期中国棉纱交易所的证据
title_primary: 价格发现与远距离市场整合：来自民国时期中国棉纱交易所的证据
title_secondary: Price discovery and long-distance market integration: Evidence from the Republican Chinese Cotton Goods Exchange
authors: Yaohua Li, Yuhan Xiao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Market integration is vital for economic development; its determinants have been extensively documented in the literature. However, relatively little attention has been paid to the role of economic organizations. This paper seeks to fill this gap by investigating the role of futures exchanges in Republican China. Using manually collected primary data, we employ a continuous difference-in-differences approach to analyze the impact of the Chinese Cotton Goods Exchange on long-distance market integration. We find that, following the exchange's establishment in 1921, geographically distant cities experienced a stronger increase in market integration with Shanghai than nearby cities. Regarding the underlying mechanism, we show that the price-discovery function of the futures exchange promoted long-distance market integration by centralizing markets and reducing price uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 市场整合对经济发展至关重要，其决定因素已在文献中得到广泛记载。然而，经济组织的作用相对较少受到关注。本文旨在通过研究民国时期期货交易所的角色来填补这一空白。利用手工收集的一手数据，我们采用连续双重差分法分析中国棉业交易所对长距离市场整合的影响。研究发现，自1921年该交易所成立后，地理上相距较远的城市与上海之间的市场整合程度增强幅度大于邻近城市。关于内在机制，我们表明期货交易所的价格发现功能通过集中市场和降低价格不确定性促进了长距离市场整合。

title: The impact of local government debt replacement on corporate financing constraints: evidence from China

abstract: Using the first-round local government debt replacement policy (LGDR) implemented in 248 Chinese cities from 2015 to 2018 as a quasi-natural experiment, this article employs an intensity DID model to investigate the impact of LGDR on corporate financing constraints. The empirical results show that LGDR significantly alleviates firms’ financing constraints. Mechanism analysis reveals that LGDR can enhance corporate credit availability by improving commercial bank liquidity, and reduce corporate financing costs by mitigating firms’ operational risks and intensifying regional banking competition. Heterogeneity analysis further indicates that the alleviating effect is more pronounced for non-state-owned enterprises, labour-intensive firms, technology-intensive firms, and firms operating in competitive industries. This study contributes to the literature by providing micro-level evidence on the economic effects of local government debt risk mitigation tools and offers new empirical insights into addressing corporate financing difficulties.

title: Religious politics and the limits of redistribution: The rise and fall of family allowances in Spain, 1926–58
title_zh: 宗教政治与再分配的局限：西班牙家庭津贴的兴衰（1926–1958）
title_primary: 宗教政治与再分配的局限：西班牙家庭津贴的兴衰（1926–1958）
title_secondary: Religious politics and the limits of redistribution: The rise and fall of family allowances in Spain, 1926–58
authors: Guillem Verd‐Llabrés
official: 官方在线 2025-09-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract After the Second World War, family allowances became a cornerstone of social spending in western Europe. Whilst religion is often highlighted as a driver of this policy, the role of political Catholicism remains contested, particularly in southern Europe. This paper examines the Spanish case, tracing the development of family allowances from their inception in 1926 to the conclusion of early Francoist labour legislation in 1958. It connects the policy preferences of political factions and interest groups to the evolution of family allowances under three political regimes. The study argues that understanding the role of social groups, particularly Catholics, requires addressing both their social policy goals and redistributive preferences. It shows Catholic cadres’ consistent advocacy for family allowances as public support for the family wage since the 1920s, despite resistance from employers and the labour movement. Their preference for corporatism and limited redistribution shaped their framing as a social insurance and occupational scheme, implementing it even before the end of the Spanish Civil War as Catholic influence increased. However, the redistributive preferences of Catholics imposed structural limits to the scheme's expansion, particularly in agriculture, further constrained by competition with Falange and the dictatorship's resistance to tax reform.
abstract_zh: 摘要 第二次世界大战后，家庭津贴成为西欧社会支出的基石。尽管宗教常被视为这一政策的驱动力，但政治天主教主义的作用仍存争议，尤其是在南欧。本文考察西班牙案例，追溯家庭津贴自1926年创立至1958年佛朗哥早期劳动立法结束的发展历程，将政治派别与利益集团的政策偏好与三个政治体制下家庭津贴的演变联系起来。研究认为，理解社会群体（尤其是天主教徒）的作用，需同时考虑其社会政策目标与再分配偏好。研究表明，自1920年代以来，天主教干部一贯主张将家庭津贴作为对家庭工资的公共支持，尽管遭到雇主和劳工运动的抵制。他们对社团主义及有限再分配的偏好，塑造了其作为社会保险和职业计划的框架，并在天主教影响力增强时，甚至在西班牙内战结束前便予以实施。然而，天主教徒的再分配偏好对该计划的扩展施加了结构性限制，尤其在农业领域，加之与长枪党的竞争及独裁政权对税收改革的抵制，进一步制约了其发展。

title: Battle of the markups: conflict inflation and the aspirational channel of monetary policy transmission
title_zh: 加价之战：冲突性通胀与货币政策传导的期望渠道
title_primary: 加价之战：冲突性通胀与货币政策传导的期望渠道
title_secondary: Battle of the markups: conflict inflation and the aspirational channel of monetary policy transmission
authors: Frederick van der Ploeg, Tim Willems
official: 官方在线 2023-09-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: After the post-Covid rise in inflation, a debate has emerged whether this inflation is "seller-driven" and, if so, how policy should respond. We build a model to capture the underlying distributional conflict between wage- and price-setters both wishing to attain a certain markup. We highlight a new "aspirational channel" of monetary transmission: by influencing cyclical conditions, a central bank can control inflation through affecting markup aspirations of workers and firms. We establish conditions under which an inflationary situation characterized by inconsistent aspirations requires a reduction in economic activity, to push demands of workers and firms towards consistency. We find that countercyclical markups and/or a flat Phillips curve call for more "dovish" monetary policy (responding less to inflation deviations, more to the output gap). Estimating price markup cyclicality across 43 countries, we find that contractionary monetary shocks indeed have stronger anti-inflationary effects in countries with greater markup procyclicality.
abstract_zh: 后疫情时代通胀上升后，学界围绕此轮通胀是否属于"卖方驱动型"以及政策应如何应对展开辩论。我们构建了一个模型，用以刻画工资制定者与价格制定者之间潜在的分配冲突——双方均希望实现特定加成率。我们揭示了货币政策传导的新"期望渠道"：通过影响经济周期条件，中央银行能够通过改变工人与企业的加成率期望来调控通胀。我们确立了相关条件：当通胀态势源于各方期望不一致时，需通过降低经济活动水平来推动工人与企业的诉求趋于一致。研究发现，反周期加成率及/或平坦的菲利普斯曲线要求采取更"鸽派"的货币政策（对通胀偏离反应更弱，对产出缺口反应更强）。基于43个国家加成率周期性的估算，我们发现紧缩性货币冲击在加成率顺周期性更强的国家确实具有更强的反通胀效应。
